items.title: George Wein — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Watched Mickey Rooney and Andy Hardy.

ctx.x: So you just said "I want to do this" and would pick up the phone and make it happen.

I always did that. I don't know why or how. I mean, it … uh, I didn't say anything like, "Hey, let's have a football team." You know The Beaver, we called. I watched … listened to the radio and watched movies all the time. Watched Mickey Rooney and Andy Hardy. If they could do it, why couldn't we do it? You know? Hey?
Ah! Okay. Now, your brother went off to college, went to New York to NYU, I believe?
